records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Gross margin dollars decreased $100.4 million and gross margin rate decreased 130 basis points to 39.0% of net sales.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Comparable sales for stores open at least fifteen months, plus our e-commerce operations, decreased $152.2 million, or 2.5%.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Inventory of $1,237.8 million represented a $297.5 million increase, or 31.6%, from 2020.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Selling and administrative expenses increased $49.1 million, which included $5.0 million of store asset impairment charges.
